Source Things have become emotional inside the Bigg Boss 20 house. TV actor Mahhi Vij was seen crying and talking about leaving the show after comments made by fellow contestant Love Gill's mother. In a promo for the November 4 episode, Mahhi became very upset. She said that the show was only showing her negative comments and not telling the full story. She also felt that the makers were showing her in a bad light. Mahhi said she did not care about losing the prize money. She explained that her reputation was more important than winning the show. The issue started during a task in which the contestants received pictures and voice messages from their family members. However, things became emotional after Love Gill's mother's comments upset Mahhi. ( Source : Deccan Chronicle ) Bigg Boss 20  India  About the Author DC Correspondent Latest News
